title: BundleBack
description: A real backpack system with upgrades and a clean GUI—made for loot-heavy servers.
body:
# BundleBack

If your players constantly fight their inventory instead of enjoying the game, BundleBack fixes it instantly. It adds a proper backpack experience: a dedicated storage item, a clean GUI, and an upgrade path that makes looting feel satisfying instead of annoying.
This is the kind of plugin you install once—and never want to play without again.

### Highlights:

Backpack item with a simple, player-friendly GUI

Upgradeable storage (progression-friendly)

Built to feel natural in survival/RPG gameplay

Great fit for dungeons, farms, grinders, and long sessions

Perfect for: RPG servers, survival+, dungeon loot, progression economies.

### Why you’ll love it

Stops inventory chaos instantly: loot more, manage less

Feels like a natural part of survival/RPG gameplay

Gives players a progression loop they actually care about

### Features

Backpack item with a clean, simple GUI

Upgradeable storage (progression-friendly)

Built for loot-heavy gameplay (dungeons, farms, grinders)

Designed to work smoothly in a bigger progression ecosystem

### Setup

Put the plugin in /plugins/

Restart the server

Configure backpacks/upgrades in the config

Test a backpack and adjust balancing to your server pace

### Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Works best with RPG/loot/economy setups

Resource pack: optional (only if you use custom models)
